summary: Consolidated TLS flow + inference-metadata prod-log extract for billing discrepancy audit
description:
Issue summary: Finance and Legal have requested a consolidated production log extract combining TLS flow metadata (netflow-style headers) and per-request inference metadata (model id, request_id, token_count, route selection) to investigate a billing discrepancy reported by a large enterprise customer. Purpose: correlate spikes in token consumption with network anomalies and routing fallbacks to determine whether invoiced usage map to legitimate inference activity.

Requirements: extract must be minimized to only the time window and fields needed, stored in an encrypted temporary bucket, and accessible to a limited set of approvers. Redaction rules must be applied prior to delivery: redact client IPs to /24, hash any customer-provided prompt text, and preserve request_id and model_id for correlation.

Deadline: legal review requests completion by 2026-03-18 due to upcoming billing dispute deadline.
impact: Customer-facing billing discrepancy under review; partial billing holds and finance escalation. Not system-wide outage but high-priority due to contractual dispute potential.
requested_data: List of fields: timestamp, request_id, tenant_id (hashed), model_id, model_version, route_selection, token_count_input, token_count_output, latency_ms, error_code, upstream_region, backend_host, tls_client_ip (to be redacted to /24), user_agent, sampling_flag. Time window: 2026-02-28T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-03T23:59:59Z.
redaction_policy: Client IPs: truncate to /24. Prompts/payloads: replace with SHA256 of original + keep length metadata. PII fields: remove any headers matching 'x-customer-*' except x-customer-id (hash). Attach redaction script and verification checksum in S3 manifest.
retention_policy: Export artifacts to be retained for 14 days from provisioning and then automatically deleted. Temporary bucket to use SSE-KMS; keys limited to the Access Approval group.
approvals_required: Approvals needed from: Legal (K. Patel), Data Privacy (A. Nguyen), Head of Security (L. Rivera). Support lead must confirm minimal scope before extraction.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - data extract and correlation request rather than a reproducible bug. SRE to run aggregation job against archived logs for specified window.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-13 - SRE initial triage: identified that inference metadata and network headers live in separate index partitions (netflow-headers-* and inference-meta-*). Planned two-step job to join on request_id where present and fallback to approximate join on timestamp+tenant_id when request_id absent.
2026-03-13 - Privacy flagged that some tenants opt out of full payload retention; will need to honor tenant-level retention flags and drop payloads accordingly.

2026-03-14 - Proposed approach: create temporary aggregation job that emits a CSV with agreed columns, post-process with redaction lambda, store in encrypted bucket with access limited to approvers. Provide MD5 and SHA256 manifest for verification.
2026-03-14 - Estimated runtime: 3-5 hours for full window across both regions; cost estimate provided to Finance in thread.
2026-03-14 - Risks: possible incomplete joins for older requests where request_id not present; flagged to Legal and noted in delivery as limitation.
Suggested mitigation: include sampling of raw unredacted entries for internal validation only (kept separate, not provided to customer) if Legal approves under supervised review.
